The retrieved medical reports indicate that lung opacities and lung lesions are present in some cases, while cardiomegaly and pleural effusion are explicitly absent. Most examinations show normal heart size and clear lungs, with some instances of chronic scarring or calcified granulomas.

- Lung opacities were noted in the lung bases in one report, though they were not considered acute.
- Calcified granulomas and scarring were identified as stable findings in the lung parenchyma.
- Heart size and mediastinal contours were consistently described as normal across all retrieved records.
- No evidence of pleural effusion, pneumothorax, or acute cardiopulmonary abnormalities was found.
